title: Maximality of the Došen–Petrić Boolean Category
abstract: We prove that the zero-identity Boolean category of Došen and Petrić freely generated by a nonempty set of propositional variables is maximal. Adjoining an equation between distinct parallel arrows and closing under the arrow operations and uniform formula substitution identifies all parallel arrows. This disproves the conjecture in Section 14.2 of the September 2007 revision of Proof-Theoretical Coherence. Boolean Coherence and composition with arrows selecting occurrences reduce the added equation to ι₁ ∘ π₁ = 0 from ℓ∧⊥ to ℓ∨⊤ for a literal ℓ. Uniform substitution and double-negation isomorphisms give this equation with any formula A in place of ℓ. Two isomorphisms listed by Došen and Petrić then yield equality of the product projections. The Lean formalization proves coherence, maximality and the model corollary for the category presented by the defining equations. It also proves the equations relating substitution on tagged occurrence sets to substitution on finite ordinals.
abstract_latex:
We prove that the zero-identity Boolean category of Do\v{s}en and
Petri\'c freely generated by a nonempty set of propositional variables
is maximal. Adjoining an equation between distinct parallel arrows
and closing under the arrow operations and uniform formula
substitution identifies all parallel arrows. This disproves the
conjecture in Section~14.2 of the September 2007 revision of
\emph{Proof-Theoretical Coherence}. Boolean Coherence and composition
with arrows selecting occurrences reduce the added equation to
$\iota_1^{\ell,\top}\circ\pi_1^{\ell,\bot}
=0_{\ell\wedge\bot,\ell\vee\top}$ for a literal $\ell$.
Uniform substitution and double-negation isomorphisms give this
equation with any formula $A$ in place of $\ell$. Two isomorphisms
listed by Do\v{s}en and Petri\'c then yield equality of the product
projections. The Lean formalization proves coherence, maximality and
the model corollary for the category presented by the defining
equations. It also proves the equations relating substitution on
tagged occurrence sets to substitution on finite ordinals.
